limits: Two paired run medians per workload are the replication units; 160 correlated large-workload steps are not 160 independent repeats. No confidence interval or universal/practically significant improvement claim.
All 40 samples and all original fixed windows are retained. Broad wall variation and different first/last windows prevent a stability claim; no outlier deletion or warmup adjustment.

The per-sample host-wall-minus-CUDA-phase remainder is negative by up to 297 ms despite sequential phase events and final synchronization. This is a material unresolved timing-validity issue, not a harmless CPU-cost remainder. The median-direction screen alone does not resolve measurement validity or qualify throughput.

All four runs have their largest forward duration at measured sample 29. No timed trace establishes compilation, clock behavior, contention or another cause; aggregate rows and clean exit logs do not prove absence of compilation.
Finite last-microbatch losses are receipts only and do not establish independent native FLASH numerical parity; they are not accumulated full-step loss measurements.
Native FLASH synthetic single-H200 resident inputs and fixed optimizer recipe only. No real-data/SFT schedule, full training service, distributed throughput or checkpoint-performance claim.
Existing native independent forward/backward baseline rejection remains; separate deterministic Triton and identical-native-gradient optimizer proofs do not relabel it.
audit_method: Independent raw-file SHA, scalar statistics and fixed-window recomputation; unchanged frozen source/admission validator; no GPU/network, sample modification, new estimator or tolerance gate.
